content_sections.heading: Sainik School Tilaiya Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: TGT (Social Sc): Four years integrated degree course of Regional College of Education of NCERT in the concerned subject with at least 50% marks in aggregate, OR Bachelor's Degree with at least 50% marks in the concerned subject / combination of subject and in aggregate TGT (Maths): Bachelor Degree in Maths with any two of the subjects: Physics, Chemistry, Electronics, Computer Science, Statistics; B.Ed or equivalent degree in relevant subject from a recognized University; Pass in the Central Teacher Eligibility Test (CTET) Paper-II conducted by CBSE Music Teacher: Higher Secondary with a degree or diploma in Music Craft & Workshop Instructor: Higher Secondary and two years trade certificate from a recognized ITI Medical Officer: MBBS from recognized institution Quartermaster: B.A/B.Com and UDC/Store experience or Ex-serviceman

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Sainik School Tilaiya Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.sainikschooltilaiya.org. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 17-11-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Sainik School Tilaiya, located in Koderma, Jharkhand, to fill multiple teaching and administrative vacancies.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 6 vacancies have been announced for various posts including TGT, Music Teacher, Craft & Workshop Instructor, Medical Officer, and Quartermaster.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date for the receipt of the filled offline application form at Sainik School Tilaiya is 17 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for Sainik School Tilaiya Recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is strictly offline. Candidates must download the application format and send it by post along with necessary enclosures.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for General and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: General and OBC candidates are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 400/- through a Demand Draft.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: SC and ST category candidates need to pay a reduced application fee of Rs. 250/- via Demand Draft.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for TGT and teaching posts?
faq.answer: The age limit for TGT and instructor posts is set between 21 and 35 years as of 01 October 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What qualifications are needed for the TGT (Social Sc) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a four-year integrated degree from Regional College of Education of NCERT or a Bachelor's Degree with at least 50% marks in the relevant subject.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection procedure for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a written test, a skill test, and a personal interview conducted by the school authorities.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the completed offline application form be sent?
faq.answer: The application form must be sent by post to The Principal, Sainik School Tilaiya, PO: Tilaiya Dam, Dist: Koderma, Jharkhand - 825413.
